Magnus Expands Access to 5-Day SAINT Depression Therapy as Leading Health Systems Scale Nationwide Adoption

outcomes.note: First definitive announcement: UAMS news release of 2024-06-11 says UAMS is 'the first medical facility in the United States to provide' SAINT and that 'currently, SAINT can only be provided to patients who are being treated as inpatients'. That is the hospital's own announcement of patient availability in a hospital inpatient setting: TRUE on 2024-06-11. The Magnus launch release of 2024-04-30 named UAMS and MUSC Health as first customer sites and quoted UAMS as 'first site in the nation to offer' SAINT, but stated no patient availability or treated patient ('will work ... to implement'), so it was not treated as definitive; a rechecker could argue for 2024-04-30. Corroboration: Magnus 2024-11-12 (MUSC Health quoted; hospital outpatient payment from 2025-01-01), MUSC 2026-04-14 (first hospital system to offer SAINT in 2024), Magnus 2026-05-05. CMS payment decisions were not used.

Federal Register full-text searches of CMS rules published since 2024-07-01 for psilocybin, MDMA, midomafetamine, psychedelic, lysergide and COMP360 each return 0 documents. No psychedelic-class drug holds FDA approval as of 2026-09-13 (FDA Novel Drug Approvals 2026 lists none through 2026-09-11), and NTAP requires an FDA-authorized product. Wave Neuroscience Announces FDA Clearance of MeRT for PTSD

outcomes.note: FDA 510(k) K260402 (Wave Neuroscience MeRT System) has decision date 2026-06-03 under 21 CFR 882.5802 with new product code SIG; the indications for use name an adjunct for treatment of adult patients with PTSD. PTSD was not an authorized TMS indication on 2024-01-04 (authorized: MDD/TRD, anxious depression, OCD, smoking cessation, sTMS migraine), so TRUE on 2026-06-03. Earlier check: every TMS 510(k) decided 2024-01-05 to 2026-06-02 carried product code OBP (MDD) or QCI (OCD); the adolescent MDD clearances (Neuronetics K231926, 2024-03-22; BrainsWay K251391, 2025-11-07) and accelerated protocols are population or protocol changes that the criterion excludes; no TMS PMA and no other new TMS product code exist. One registry reading says a new population counts; the criterion as written excludes it and governs here. Under that reading the date would be 2024-03-22 (K231926).

evidence.title: BPL-003 Efficacy and Safety in Treatment Resistant Depression (NCT05870540), Beckley Psytech Limited; results first posted 2026-09-10

outcomes.note: Sponsor topline press release dated 2025-07-01 (also filed as an 8-K exhibit the same day) reports the primary endpoint of the quadruple-masked, dose-finding core stage of Phase 2b NCT05870540 (Beckley Psytech Limited, parent atai): change from baseline in MADRS at Day 29, 12 mg vs 0.3 mg BPL-003, -11.1 vs -5.8 points, p=0.0038; 193 participants, 38 sites, 6 countries. This is the randomized core-stage primary result, not a Phase 2a, open-label, interim or pooled analysis, so TRUE on 2025-07-01. ClinicalTrials.gov results were posted later (2026-09-10) and match the primary outcome measure.

Perception Neuroscience' and reports Otsuka's January 2025 notice terminating its Japan arketamine license effective 2025-04-24 (a licensee action, not sponsor discontinuation). The FY2025 10-K (2026-03-06) and Q2 2026 10-Q (2026-08-11) still report direct R&D expenses for PCN-101 and Perception Neuroscience as a 59.2%-owned controlled VIE; PCN-101 is absent from the pipeline text, but no filing or release says development is discontinued or removed with no further development planned. A partner search or deprioritization is not discontinuation under the criterion. Wikipedia's 'previous candidate' label has no sponsor source. Not occurred as of 2026-09-13.

evidence.title: MAPS Responds to Report of Progress for MDMA-assisted therapy for PTSD with FDA

outcomes.note: The criterion can only be applied once the FDA approves a psychedelic-class drug. As of 2026-09-13 none is approved: Drugs@FDA (openFDA) has no entry for psilocybin, psilocin, midomafetamine/MDMA, lysergide, ibogaine, mebufotenin or DMT; FDA Novel Drug Approvals 2026 lists 39 approvals through 2026-09-11, none in the class; REMS@FDA lists no psychedelic REMS. Nearest candidates: COMP360 psilocybin NDA in rolling submission, all modules due Q4 2026, launch expected H1 2027 subject to approval (Compass, 2026-08-05); midomafetamine NDA resubmitted August 2026, decision pending (MAPS, 2026-08-10); DT120 lysergide has Phase 3 results but no NDA. The criterion says that with no class approval the condition is unmet and the item is void, so neither TRUE nor FALSE applies: unresolvable as of 2026-09-13. Re-check REMS@FDA on the approval date if a class approval arrives before the deadline.
